OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.ocrRequestFromJson("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/multipage.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.ocr(_req)
debugPrint(result.pages)
debugPrint(result.pages[0].index)
debugPrint(result.pages[1].index)
```
